source: TrustLensAI_Recommender_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Recommender RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Recommender pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.key_fields: candidate item set, retrieval source (ANN/CF/two-tower), cold-start path
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: enriched context, session state, real-time signals
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: candidate scores, predicted engagement, ranked positions
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance
layers.notes: Core log for RQ, RS-04, CC families

layers.key_fields: business-rule adjustments, boosts/demotions, constraints applied
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: list composition, intra-list diversity, novelty, coverage
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: predicted vs observed engagement, calibration bins, popularity match
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: impressions by provider & group, exposure parity, calibrated fairness
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: logged feedback, retraining cadence, bias/exposure across cycles
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L2 · Observability → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: preference drift, online-offline gap, incidents, staleness
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L2 · Observability → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: registry, lineage, A/B & champion-challenger, audit trail, TEVV

layers.key_fields: evaluator outputs, ranking/diversity/fairness/calibration scores
